title: Public Pathway Consolidation v5r4: executable generator-population four-assay instrument
summary: A closed, generator-population causal instrument for supported candidate selection, observable every-edge interleaved-response dependence, frozen DREAM context-policy value, and the total effect of DREAM-guided evidence-to-READ training. It replaces finite-roster average ITT with directly observed paired life outcomes, closes state/queue/status/claim DAGs, and makes every acceptance result executable.
system_thesis: Experience Models should ultimately convert verified lived experience into prospective cognition. PPC5r4 does not test that flywheel. It tests four separately identified prerequisites while freezing THINK, DREAM, and ACT and restricting learning to candidate scoring. Success is only a qualified non-mediational intersection over the locked generator population; learned cognition, continual improvement, compression, parenting, populations, and scaling remain later hypotheses.
